sql.propToolFinancier.getAllForCompany: select f.id, f.financier, f.company_id, f.archived from props.financier f where f.company_id = :companyId and f.archived is not true order by f.financier
sql.propToolFinancier.update: update props.financier set financier = :financier where id = :id
sql.propToolFinancier.delete: update props.financier set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
